verdict.rationale: First-party docs explicitly describe hourly time entries and overtime flowing directly into payroll: approved hours from T&A flow instantly to Payroll with no manual syncing, timesheets reviewable inside each pay run, and automatic application of overtime/labor policies by location. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the overtime-to-payroll flow specifically (the community CSV-delay incident is about a general payroll processing error, not about time/overtime sync failing).
